headline: Pressure is force distributed across area—the same force feels different depending on how it's spread
universal_truth: Concentration amplifies; distribution dilutes; how force is spread matters as much as how much force
fun_facts: A stiletto heel exerts more pressure per square inch than an elephant's foot
Lying on a bed of nails works because weight is distributed across many points
Deep sea creatures can survive crushing pressures that would destroy surface animals instantly
discussion_questions: Where are you spreading yourself too thin?
What would benefit from concentrated focus?
How do you manage the 'pressure' in your life?

hook.script: A hundred-pound person in stiletto heels exerts more pressure than a two-ton elephant. How? Pressure is force divided by area. Concentrate force on a tiny point, and pressure skyrockets. Spread it across a large surface, and pressure drops. Distribution changes everything.

cliff.script: Pressure is a physics concept, but it applies to life. The same amount of work spread over a month feels different than compressed into a week. How does understanding pressure help us?
cliff.prompt: How can we apply pressure thinking?

options.text: Concentrate force where you want impact; distribute load where you want to reduce strain—managing pressure means managing where and how force is applied
options.response: Yes. Want breakthrough? Concentrate. Feeling crushed? Distribute. Pressure is manageable through controlling either the force or the area it's applied over.

options.text: Reduce the total force to reduce pressure
options.response: Reducing force helps, but sometimes you can't—distribution is the other lever...

fact1.title: Concentration Effect
fact1.script: Knives work because force concentrates on a thin edge. Needles penetrate because force focuses on a point. When you want impact, concentrate. Spreading too thin means nothing breaks through.

fact2.title: Distribution Effect
fact2.script: Snowshoes work because weight distributes across a large area. Mattresses are comfortable because pressure spreads evenly. When you want to reduce strain, distribute. What crushes when concentrated can be bearable when spread.

fact3.title: Life Pressure
fact3.script: You have finite energy and attention—finite 'force.' Spread across too many commitments, pressure everywhere is low and nothing gets done. Concentrate on priorities, and you can break through where it matters.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Concentration amplifies; distribution dilutes. How force is spread matters as much as how much force. Manage pressure by managing focus.

outro.script: That's Day 220! Tomorrow, we'll explore pushes and pulls—forces. Until then, identify where you need to concentrate and where you need to distribute.

growTrack.title: Pressure Management - Concentrate or Distribute?
growTrack.learning_objective: Apply pressure concepts to focus and workload
growTrack.activity: Look at your current commitments. Where are you spreading too thin, reducing impact? Where could concentrating effort create breakthrough? Also: where is pressure crushing you that could be distributed—delegated, scheduled differently, or shared?
